text.formatted:
As a Bonus Action, you can do one of the following.

_**Sleight of Hand.**_ Make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check to pick a lock or disarm a trap with Thieves' Tools or to pick a pocket.

_**Use an Object.**_ Take the Utilize action, or take the Magic action to use a magic item that requires that action.
